name: CME Crypto Futures Basis & Carry Analysis
description: Compares CME Bitcoin (BTC) and Ether (ER) futures against spot prices (Coinbase) to analyze the futures basis premium and term structure carry. Metrics include: average basis (bps), annualized basis, % time in contango/backwardation, average carry (M1/M2 term structure), and annualized carry. Visualizations: cross-sectional basis and carry time series (20d MA), plus per-asset distribution histograms for each.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CME CRYPTO FUTURES BASIS & CARRY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Compares CME Bitcoin (BT) and Ether (ER) futures vs spot (Coinbase)
# to measure the futures premium and term structure carry.
#
# Basis = (Futures Close - Spot Close) / Spot Close × 10,000 (bps)
# Carry = futures_continuation built-in M1/M2 term structure ratio
# Annualized = daily value × 365
#
# Dashboard:
#   1. Cross-sectional summary table (key metrics per asset)
#   2. Basis time series (cs_lines)
#   3. Carry time series (cs_lines)
#   4. Basis distribution (histogram per asset)
#   5. Carry distribution (histogram per asset)
# =============================================================================

# --- Spot Prices (from universe assets: BTCUSD, ETHUSD) ---
spot_src = market_data_source()()
spot_close = spot_src.c

# --- CME BTC Futures (reference, with continuation) ---
btc_fut_raw = reference_futures(ticker="BT")()
btc_fut = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(btc_fut_raw.o, btc_fut_raw.h, btc_fut_raw.l, btc_fut_raw.c, btc_fut_raw.v, btc_fut_raw.oi, btc_fut_raw.s)
btc_fut_close = btc_fut.c
btc_carry = btc_fut.carry

# --- CME ETH Futures (reference, with continuation) ---
eth_fut_raw = reference_futures(ticker="ER")()
eth_fut = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(eth_fut_raw.o, eth_fut_raw.h, eth_fut_raw.l, eth_fut_raw.c, eth_fut_raw.v, eth_fut_raw.oi, eth_fut_raw.s)
eth_fut_close = eth_fut.c
eth_carry = eth_fut.carry

# --- Compute Basis (bps) ---
# For BTC universe asset: use BTC futures; for ETH universe asset: use ETH futures
# Since reference_futures data is the same across all universe assets,
# we use is_asset_ref to select the correct futures price per asset
is_btc = is_asset_ref(ticker="^BTCUSD-Crypto")()
is_eth = is_asset_ref(ticker="^ETHUSD-Crypto")()

# Select the correct futures close per asset
fut_close = where(is_btc, btc_fut_close, where(is_eth, eth_fut_close, 0.0 / 0.0))

# Select the correct carry per asset
carry_raw = where(is_btc, btc_carry, where(is_eth, eth_carry, 0.0 / 0.0))

# Basis in basis points: (futures - spot) / spot × 10,000
basis_bps = (fut_close - spot_close) / spot_close * 10000

# Annualized basis (daily basis × 365)
basis_ann = basis_bps * 365

# Carry annualized (carry is M1/M2 ratio - 1, annualize × 365)
carry_ann = carry_raw * 365

# --- Metrics for Summary Table ---
# % time in contango (basis > 0 means futures premium = contango)
is_contango = basis_bps > 0
pct_contango = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(is_contango)
pct_backwardation = 1 - pct_contango

# Cumulative averages for summary
avg_basis_bps = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(basis_bps)
avg_basis_ann = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(basis_ann)
avg_carry = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(carry_raw)
avg_carry_ann = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(carry_ann)

# --- Smoothed series for line charts (20-day MA for readability) ---
basis_smooth = ma(period=20)(basis_bps)
carry_smooth = ma(period=20)(carry_raw)

# --- Timestamps for line charts ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# 1. Cross-Sectional Summary Table
cs_summary_table(
    title='CME Futures Basis & Carry Summary',
    category='1. Key Metrics',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=1,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='CME Futures Basis & Carry Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Basis (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Basis Ann. (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(title='% Time Contango', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='% Time Backwardation', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Carry (daily)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Carry Ann.', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(avg_basis_bps, avg_basis_ann, pct_contango, pct_backwardation, avg_carry, avg_carry_ann)

# 2. Basis Over Time (20-day smoothed, both assets on same chart)
cs_lines(
    title='Futures Basis Over Time (20d MA, bps)',
    category='2. Basis Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Basis (bps)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, basis_smooth)

# 3. Carry Over Time (20-day smoothed, both assets on same chart)
cs_lines(
    title='Term Structure Carry Over Time (20d MA)',
    category='3. Carry Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, carry_smooth)

# 4. Basis Distribution (histogram per asset)
histogram(
    title='Futures Basis Distribution (bps)',
    category='2. Basis Analysis',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Basis (bps)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=2
)(basis_bps)

# 5. Carry Distribution (histogram per asset)
histogram(
    title='Carry Distribution (Daily)',
    category='3. Carry Analysis',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=2
)(carry_raw)
